task: Touch up trim and baseboard paint
steps: Clean the trim with a damp cloth to remove dust/grime.
Lightly sand any rough or chipped spots.
Apply painter's tape to protect adjacent walls/flooring.
Use a small angled brush to apply matching trim paint in thin coats.
Remove tape before the paint fully dries to avoid peeling.

materials.name: BEHR Premium Plus semi-gloss enamel trim paint
Purdy XL Glide 2-1/2 in. angular sash brush
ScotchBlue 2090 1.88 in. x 60 yd painter's tape
